summary: Read k singly linked chains, and k may be 0. Inside each chain, the integers in the nodes already run from small to large. Gather every node from all chains into exactly one chain, and that combined chain must also run from small to large. Pointers may be rewritten, but integers inside nodes may not. Write the head of the combined chain. When no node exists, write an empty result.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
